0.original: <hex:024804F201FC03><hex:024904F201FD03> Quest Sync<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103><hex:02100103>The vacillating Loporrit is in need of help.

26.original: Assume your /battlestance for the Loporrit tailor.

48.original: Oh! It's you! Uh... If it's not too much trouble, I could really use your help!

49.original: We've been making clothes for your people, but after speaking with Livingway, I realized we've made a grave mistake!

50.original: Considerable alterations must be made to our plans, and I was hoping you might join me to speak with the Loporrit in charge of garment adjustments.

51.original: Thank you! They're not going to be happy about this...

52.original: I'm telling you, we're doing it all wrong! We have to fix these clothes before it's too late!

53.original: How are we supposed to resize everything when we don't even know what to base the alterations on?

54.original: Oh! You must be the model, then. I see... You really are like a baby carrot.

55.original: Perhaps an explanation is in order... You see, we'd like you to help us redefine the style of the clothing we create.

56.original: We believe comfort and familiarity are key to accommodating the people of Etheirys...which is why we thought masks and all-purpose robes would suffice.

57.original: When Livingway claimed the fashion trends of Etheirys are far removed from what we were anticipating, I was incredulous, but meeting you made everything painfully clear!

58.original: Indeed. I see now that our plans won't do. Your garments are so vibrant and...unique.

59.original: We still need to decide what adjustments to make, so would you please stay a while?

60.original: Thank you. Now, be a dear and strike a <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>pose<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> for me, will you? I want to get an idea of how the fabric moves with you.

61.original: If you could <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>pose<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> for me, that would be a great help.

62.original: No need to be shy. There's no one watching but the two of us. Go ahead and give us a <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>pose<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.

63.original: The Loporrit tailor watches you intently. Strike a <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>pose<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> to show off your garb.

64.original: Yes, just like that! Hmm... I see. May I ask why you chose to wear this outfit?

68.original: Not sure <hex:021A020203>what<hex:021A020103> I was thinking, to be honest.

69.original: So people find designs like this aesthetically pleasing? I'll have to bear that in mind when I redesign our concepts...

70.original: Ah, so it's not only form that appeals to you, but function as well! A practical choice, I suppose, if you're to take to the battlefield...

71.original: What, did you choose it with your eyes closed? Ugh... Well, I suppose it just goes to show how very routine clothing is to you.

72.original: Might I see your <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>battle stance<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> next? If the people of Etheirys have need to fight, I'd like to be certain their clothes strike fear in the hearts of their enemies.

73.original: I'm fairly sure that if I were to wander onto a battlefield, I'd be turned into a pelt in no time...

74.original: Would you show me your most valiant <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>battle stance<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>? Your clothes must be stylish, but they must also strike fear into the hearts of your enemies! ...People enjoy that, yes?

75.original: The Loporrit tailor watches you intently. Assume a <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>battle stance<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> to show off your garb.

76.original: Yes... I believe I have a solid grasp of what our designs were lacking before.

77.original: Truly, I never realized that one's choice of attire could make such an impression!

78.original: And that ensemble quite befits your personality, I must say.

79.original: ...Which means we can't just throw the same garb on everyone. What is that saying you have? Ah, yes─“variety is the spice of life”!

80.original: You have given me so many new ideas, I can hardly wait to get started! In fact, I cannot wait at all!

81.original: Er... Right, then. Would you care to follow me back to my station?

82.original: I do believe that we have a much better idea of what we should be making now, and the necessary alterations should prove little trouble.

83.original: Just you wait─someday soon, the people of Etheirys will be clamoring for the latest fashions from Bestways Burrow!

84.original: ...Assuming I get back to work, that is. Thank you for your help!
